description: This file provides utility functions to invoke flex and bison tools for generating lexer and parser code, including platform-specific path handling, SHA1 checksum retrieval, and automation of code generation processes.

methods.name: get_tool_path_platform
methods.description: Constructs the path to a tool based on platform-specific directory structure.

methods.name: get_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the full path to a tool executable, considering platform-specific extensions.

methods.name: get_tool_file_sha1s
methods.description: Returns a list of SHA1 checksum file paths for various tools and DLLs used in the build process.

methods.name: run_flex
methods.description: Executes the flex tool to generate lexer code from a given basename.

methods.name: run_bison
methods.description: Executes the bison tool to generate parser code from a given basename, optionally generating header files.

methods.name: get_input_files
methods.description: Returns the list of input source files (.l and .y) for a given basename.

methods.name: get_output_files
methods.description: Returns the list of output generated files, including lexer and parser code, and optionally header files.

methods.name: generate_parser
methods.description: Main function to generate parser and lexer code by invoking flex and bison, or to output input/output file lists based on command-line arguments.
